name: harness-comms
title: Harness Communications
description: Draft stakeholder communications for tracked work: status trackers, meeting-slot comparisons and sync-up invites, and email updates or thread replies. Use /harness-comms or /hn-comms with list, slots, or upsert. Overlaps with harness-doc on reader-facing prose and harness-monitor on status and owner evidence; owns time-bound coordination artifacts and can register their links afterward through harness-link. Drafts only: never sends, invites, or shares without explicit approval.
author: wzlwit

inputs.name: action
inputs.description: Omitted means read-only listing. Create and update are aliases for upsert.

inputs.name: artifact
inputs.description: Draft to create or update; required for upsert unless clear from the conversation.

inputs.name: thread
inputs.description: Exact subject of an existing mail thread: the reply-all target for email, and an attendee source for slots or meeting.

inputs.name: required
inputs.description: Required attendees for slots or meeting; defaults to thread participants who own open items, confirmed with the user.

inputs.name: optional
inputs.description: Optional attendees whose availability is reported but does not drive the ranking.
